Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 6684 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-04–2026-06), queried against Hammersmith and Fulham's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 2.6185 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (104% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 10.9828 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (90% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 213,315 (2021 resident population of 183,200, scaled by a measured resident-vs-workday ratio from the ONS's 2011 Census release for Hammersmith and Fulham — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.

Frequently asked questions

Is Hammersmith and Fulham safe?

Based on real, current UK Police data, Wandroz rates Hammersmith and Fulham as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night, relative to the other London boroughs currently on the automated pipeline. The rating comes from 6684 recorded incidents over 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06), split into a day-weighted score (property crime) and a night-weighted score (violence, robbery, antisocial behaviour).

Is Hammersmith and Fulham safe at night?

Hammersmith and Fulham's night score is roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz, based on the categories most relevant after dark (violence, robbery, street theft, public order, antisocial behaviour), normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population rather than plain residents where that data exists, so busy central boroughs aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents.

What official data is Hammersmith and Fulham's rating based on?

6684 recorded incidents from data.police.uk (the UK Police's official open crime API), queried against Hammersmith and Fulham's real administrative boundary and covering 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06) — refreshed automatically every month, not a one-off snapshot. Full category breakdown is shown further down this page.
